name: Wisewin Innotech Group Limited
summary: Wisewin Innotech Group Limited an investment holding company, operates as a wet trades contractor in Hong Kon and construction works in Cambodia. The company undertakes plastering, tile laying, brick laying, floor screeding, and marble works for public or private residential and commercial properties. Wisewin Innotech Group Limited was formerly known as GC Construction Holdings Limited and change its name to Wisewin Innotech Group Limited in October 2026. The company was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Kowloon, Hong Kong.
